item.title: Zelenskyy says he plans to meet Trump in Florida for peace talks Sunday
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that he will meet with US President Donald Trump in Florida on Sunday to discuss a 20-point peace plan to end the four-year war in Ukraine.

item.title: Contamination concern: Recycling for a sustainable holiday season in Indianapolis
item.description: The Indianapolis Department of Public Works has seven public drop-off recycling sites available across Marion County, but people must be mindful of what's recyclable to avoid contaminating entire truckloads of recyclable items.

item.title: Players revive Boxing Day women’s rugby tradition
item.description: The Indianapolis rugby clubs held their annual Boxing Day matches, with the women's teams returning to the pitch for their first Boxing Day games since the COVID-19 pandemic.

item.title: Woman fatally struck by SUV in Indianapolis, driver remains at large
item.description: Indianapolis police are searching for the driver of an SUV that hit and killed a woman on the city's southwest side, after the vehicle was found abandoned 3 miles away from the scene.

item.title: Jewelry, art, and community: Locals celebrate Kwanzaa
item.description: Kwanzaa, a weeklong cultural celebration of African American heritage and values, began today with a focus on unity, as vendors at the Amp at 16 Tech in Indianapolis showcased handmade items representing the principle of unity.

item.title: Flight delays and cancellations mount as winter storm hits northeast US
item.description: Thousands of flights in the US have been canceled or delayed due to severe winter storm warnings, with JetBlue Airways canceling the most flights at 225.
